mapper.insert: insert into order_close_outbox (message_id, order_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, create_time, update_time) values (#{messageId}, #{orderId}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{lastError}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update order_close_outbox set retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 0
